findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed an accumulation of mold on the baffles of the ice machine. Discussed with PIC and machine was cleaned. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned frequently and free of mold build up. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text: 2-102.11(C) (Pf) The facility did not have employee reporting agreements available during the inspection. These agreements are needed in order to ensure employees do not report to work while sick, which could spread illness or disease. Employees in the facility signed reporting agreements during the inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths were wet and laying on the bar counter top. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animal foods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Cloths sitting out were moved to sanitizer solution. Reference 3-304.14.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed all the soda nozzle holders to be soiled with mildew. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation. The soda nozzle holders were cleaned during the inspection, and the manager stated new ones have already been ordered. Reference 4-602.13.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625/3.07 Sec.. 3.07. Allergen awareness training.
(b) Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Observed PIC wash hands at 3 compartment sink. CORRECTED- Discussed with PIC. Rewash hands.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15 FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK or APPROVED automatic handwashing facility and may not clean their hands in a sink used for FOOD preparation or WAREWASHING, or in a service sink or a curbed cleaning facility used for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste. (Pf)

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed 2 soiled soda nozzles at the bar. Observed soil build up in the ice machine.  CORRECTED- Food contact surfaces were washed rinsed and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11 EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. (Pf)

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment: Observed wet wiping cloth stored on dirty side of 3 compartment sink drainboard. Store wet wiping cloths submerged in sanitizer solution.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14 (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and other EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be (1) Held between uses in a chemical sanitizer solution at a concentration specified under § 4-501.114. (C)

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment: Observed knife on prep line stored between in the gap between the counter and hot-holding equipment. Observed knives stored in wooden knife block. Store knives on clean, sanitized surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12 Store in-use utensils: 1) in the food with the handle above the top of the food item; 2) on a clean and sanitized surface; 3) in running water; 4) in a container of hot water maintained at or above 135 °F.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
No CFM has completed allergen awareness training.
410 ILCS 625 Sec. 3.07 Unless otherwise provided, all certified food service sanitation managers employed by a restaurant must receive or obtain training in basic allergen awareness principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Training programs must be accredited by the American National Standards Institute or another reputable accreditation agency. (C)

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Observed baffle of ice machine to be soiled with black slime mold. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17  (Pf) Observed  Date of 2/27 marked on green peppers and fish sauce in cooler exceeds the time limit. Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours must be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the food must be consumed on the premises, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 41?F or less for a maximum of 7 days. Discussed applicable sections of 3-501.17 and reviewed HACCP concepts with person in charge. Food was discarded. Reference 3-501.17.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.citation_text: 4-101.11  (P) Observed  In-use cutting board with deep gouges and grooves. The cutting board can no longer be washed and sanitized properly to prevent pathogen growth. Reference 4-101.11.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C)Floor in the kitchen area behind fryer was found in a state of disrepair, or not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment: PA-100-0367 - All certified food managers working in a restaurant must complete additional allergen training using an approved allergen awareness training program.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Observed improper cooling of the following foods: ground beef, cheese sauce, and shredded chicken. Items were not properly marked with time removed from heat control. Mark items that are being cooled with time removed from heat control. Facility has two hours reduce temperature from 135F or above to 70F, and then an additional four hours to have food temperatures reduced to 41F or below. Items were placed in an ice bath to speed up cooling.
750-140b Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41°F.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
Observed all the ice bins throughout establishment to be missing covers. Provide covers for ice bins that are used for human consumption.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the ice deflector in the ice machine to be soiled with an accumulation of mold. Remove ice and wash, rinse, and sanitize inside ice machine.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the general surfaces of the grill, oven, and burner to be soiled with an accumulation of grease and char. Clean these non-food contact surfaces.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
REPEAT 1X> 1) Observed cooking utensils to be stored in a bucket in the kitchen with food contact surfaces exposed for handling. Store utensils with handles extended out.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the men's restroom left hand sink to have a large crack running across top surface. Replace sink or caulk crack to make for a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.
